entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I ordered this jersey and it's just... it's not right. The website was a little confusing and I'm not sure what to do next. I'm just so overwhelmed.

I can certainly help you with that. I understand these things can be a bit confusing sometimes. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, a preference, I guess? I just got the wrong size. It's way too tight on me, and I don't think I can ride in it. I was hoping to do an exchange for a bigger size, but I couldn't figure out the return portal. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. It sounds like you just need a different size, which is a very common reason for a return. Let me just confirm a few details. When did you receive the jersey?
Um, I think about a week ago. Maybe last Saturday?
Okay, not a problem at all. I'm checking our policy for you right now. Since the jersey is a standard apparel item, it falls under our 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief. I was so worried I missed the deadline.

Not at all. I'm processing the return for you now. I can send a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account, and you can use that to send the wrong size back to us. Would you prefer a full refund or would you like me to process an exchange for the next size up?
An exchange would be wonderful! Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so easy.

You are very welcome. I've just sent that email with the return label. Once we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the new size to you immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
